question: Toplam dagitim miktarini hesapla
join_path: left_table='PO_HEADERS_ALL' right_table='PO_LINES_ALL' join_type=<JoinType.INNER: 'INNER'> on=[JoinCondition(left_table='PO_HEADERS_ALL', left_column='po_header_id', right_table='PO_LINES_ALL', right_column='po_header_id')]

left_table='PO_LINES_ALL' right_table='PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL' join_type=<JoinType.INNER: 'INNER'> on=[JoinCondition(left_table='PO_LINES_ALL', left_column='po_line_id', right_table='PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL', right_column='po_line_id')]

left_table='PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL' right_table='PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL' join_type=<JoinType.INNER: 'INNER'> on=[JoinCondition(left_table='PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL', left_column='line_location_id', right_table='PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL', right_column='line_location_id')]
semantic_intent: Dağıtım bazında sipariş tutar analizini göster
compiled_sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
SELECT p4.code_combination_id, SUM(p4.quantity_ordered) AS ordered_qty, SUM(p2.unit_price) AS price_sum, (p2.quantity * p2.unit_price) AS total_amount
FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL p
INNER JOIN PO_LINES_ALL p2 ON p.po_header_id = p2.po_header_id
INNER JOIN PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL p3 ON p2.po_line_id = p3.po_line_id
INNER JOIN PO_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL p4 ON p3.line_location_id = p4.line_location_id
GROUP BY p4.code_combination_id
ORDER BY p4.quantity_ordered DESC
)
WHERE ROWNUM <= :p1
